newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mercedes - talks to make car with Porsche collapse.
newsitem.headline: Mercedes - talks to make car with Porsche collapse.

text.p: Mercedes-Benz AG said on Friday that talks with sports car maker Dr.Ing.h.c.F Porsche AG to jointly produce an up-market sport utility vehicle had broken down.
A Mercedes spokesman said that the talks had broken down because of worries that the proposed vehicle would not be profitable enough.
The two carmakers had been looking for a way to cooperate on producing a top-end version of the Mercedes M-Class vehicle since last summer.
The M-Class, which is to be made in the U.S., is set to roll off assembly lines later this year.
Porsche had been looking for a partner to develop such a car to help it diversify from its dependence on the sports car market.
